# GitHub Copilot instructions for the Envy repository

Read **`AGENTS.md`** for the full ruleset. This file is a thin pointer.

## Essentials

- Windows MFC P2P client; VS 2026 / toolset **v145** / C++20 (C++17 plugins)
- Build: `Visual Studio/Envy.sln` + vcpkg manifest (see AGENTS.md)
- Branch from `develop`; never push to protected branches
- Shared work tracking: GitHub Issues, Projects, Milestones, PRs
- Volatile notes: `.local/` (gitignored); reference clients: `references/` (gitignored)
- English for all repository artifacts
